reason: I re-ran the analysis. Once size, age and prior patenting are controlled, the remote_share coefficient is statistically null in the full sample (about -0.28, SE 0.24), in the central region (about +0.2, SE 0.40) and in the north. The unadjusted positive association (about 1.6) disappears with controls, so it is confounding. The central-only restriction is not well justified, but it doesn't drive the null. The report should say 'no detectable effect' and note the wide confidence interval.
